# QuickTrust
> Compliance automation and scoped implementation support

QuickTrust helps teams organize policies, controls and evidence, review gaps,
prepare security questionnaire responses, and plan remediation work.
Implementation support is scoped to the customer's environment and responsibilities.
An independent auditor or certification body determines assessment outcomes.
SOC 2 is an attestation report, and HIPAA compliance is not a QuickTrust-issued certification.
